title: Operator view: WorkerView and GET /operator/api/workers response
description: Frozen shape produced by the operator command center (Worker 13) and consumed by its UI. Golden Rule: no fabricated capability, cost, provider, or status — absent evidence is UNKNOWN/disabled. Capability derivation provenance: controls are derived by src/capability.mjs from Worker 9's published command-contract v1; Worker 9 remains the enforcement authority (its 409 is final).

reason.description: Machine-readable explanation when allowed is false (e.g. status_unknown, stale_heartbeat, missing_heartbeat, state_paused_rejects_run, orchestrator_not_connected). Null when allowed is true.

controls.description: Populated ONLY by capability.deriveControls; derived from Worker 9 command-contract v1. A UI control is enabled iff allowed === true.

cost.description: Integer micro-USD. Never fabricated: absent evidence => null => rendered UNKNOWN. truthState SUPERVISOR_RECORDED means the figures come from Worker 9's work-packet budget fields; UNKNOWN means no evidence was available.

workerView.description: Normalized per-worker object (camelCase), produced by core.normalizePacket / core.unknownWorker from a raw Worker 9 packet.

status.description: Effective status after staleness override: RUNNING with a stale/missing heartbeat collapses to UNKNOWN.

reportedState.description: Raw Worker 9 packet state before staleness override; null when no packet evidence exists.

statusEvidence.description: Provenance of the status claim, e.g. "worker9-packet" or "none".

provider.description: Always null today (Worker 9 exposes no provider) => UI shows UNKNOWN.

heartbeatFresh.description: False when the heartbeat is missing or older than HEARTBEAT_STALE_MS (10 minutes, matching Worker 9's lease).

reason.description: Null when connected; otherwise NOT_CONFIGURED | TIMEOUT | UNAVAILABLE | AUTH_REJECTED | HTTP_<n> | INVALID_PAYLOAD.

capabilitySource.description: Explicit provenance: capabilities are derived, not advertised; Worker 9 enforces.
